name: Context Menu
description: A right-click action menu attached to any element, sharing the Menu item contract.
usage:

anatomy.description: The wrapped children that open the menu on right-click or the keyboard menu key.
The floating action list, named by the label prop, sharing Menu's keyboard model.
One action with label, optional icon, disabled state, separatorBefore, and danger variant.

dos: Mirror actions that are also reachable elsewhere, like a row toolbar or Menu.
Pass a label so the menu is announced with the target's context.
Isolate destructive items with separatorBefore and the danger variant.
donts: Don't make any action reachable only through right-click; touch and keyboard users need a visible path.
Don't attach context menus to small inline text where selection is the primary gesture.
Don't duplicate the page's primary actions; keep it to secondary, target-specific ones.

examples.title: Right-click actions
examples.description: Items support icons, separators, disabled states, and the danger variant like Menu.

examples.title: Disabled and danger items
examples.description: Unavailable actions stay visible but disabled; destructive ones keep the danger styling.

examples.title: Separated danger
examples.description: Keep destructive context actions at the end behind a separator.

guidance.useWhen: An element has secondary actions discoverable on right-click.
guidance.avoidWhen: The actions are primary; keep them visible instead.
guidance.behavior: Shares the Menu item contract with icons, separators, and danger styling.
guidance.responsive: Provide a visible alternative on touch layouts.

keyboard.action: Opens the menu from the keyboard on the focused target.
Moves the highlight between items, skipping disabled ones.
Activates the highlighted item and closes the menu.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the target.

notes: Shares Menu's ARIA menu pattern with menuitem roles and roving highlight.
The menu is named by the required label prop so the target context is announced.
Right-click is pointer-only; every action must also be reachable through a visible control.

props.description: Element the menu is attached to; opens on right-click and receives trigger props automatically.
props.name: children
